Everything your roofing business needs to capture and convert leads — a custom-built website, full Google Business Profile setup, Atlas AI Receptionist running 24/7, missed call text-back, 10+ lead automations, smart booking system, satellite roof estimator, lead capture funnels, and a real-time analytics dashboard. One flat price, no hidden add-ons.

Most clients are fully live in 3 to 4 days. We handle everything — building your website, setting up your Google Business Profile, training Atlas on your business, and activating all automations. You just show up to the onboarding call.

The one-time setup fee covers the real hard costs of getting your system built: domain registration, your business phone number, A2P 10DLC carrier registration (required for SMS), and brand registration. The $499 Foundation plan has a $59 setup fee and the $899 BuilderPro OS plan has a $199 setup fee. The Enterprise plan is performance-based — you pay per qualified lead plus your ad budget and a monthly management retainer — so its setup is scoped to your campaign.

Atlas is your 24/7 AI receptionist. When you miss a call, Atlas texts the caller back within seconds, answers questions about your services, qualifies leads, and books inspections directly into your calendar. Atlas is trained on your specific business so it sounds like your company, not a generic bot.

No long-term contracts. You can cancel anytime. We earn your business every month by delivering results — not by locking you into a 12-month agreement.

You pay the one-time setup fee today, we get everything built and live within 3–4 days, and then your 14-day trial begins. You use the full system completely live with real leads. At the end of 14 days, if you want to continue, your monthly billing starts. If not, you walk away with no additional charges.

The $499 Foundation plan gives you the core setup — website, Google Business Profile, missed call text-back, and basic booking. The $899 BuilderPro OS plan adds Atlas AI Receptionist, 10+ automations, the satellite roof estimator, AI search ranking, the analytics dashboard, advanced lead funnels, and priority support with monthly results reviews.

No. Everything is done for you. We build it, set it up, and manage it. You'll get a simple dashboard where you can see your leads, booked appointments, and performance — but you don't need to touch anything technical.

An AI-powered tool embedded on your website that lets homeowners enter their address and get an instant roof estimate using real satellite imagery. Before showing the result, it captures their name, phone, and email — so every estimate request becomes a qualified lead automatically sent to your system.

BuilderPro OS
Privacy Policy
Effective Date: 2025

BuilderPro OS respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our website, software platform, and services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal information including your name, email address, phone number, business information, payment information, IP/device information, and usage data. This is collected when you fill out a form, sign up for services, contact us, or use BuilderPro OS tools.

How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to provide and maintain our services, improve platform performance, communicate about your account, process payments, provide support, and send notifications related to appointments, services, or platform activity.

SMS Communications

If you consent to receive SMS, you may receive messages related to appointment confirmations, reminders, support updates, and service notifications. Message frequency may vary; message and data rates may apply.

You can opt out at any time by replying STOP. For assistance, reply HELP. SMS opt-in information and phone numbers will not be sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

Information Sharing & Security

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with trusted providers only when necessary to operate the platform, process payments, deliver services, or comply with legal requirements. We implement appropriate technical measures to protect your data, though no online system can guarantee 100% security.

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. Requests may be submitted through our website.

BuilderPro OS
Terms of Service
Effective Date: 2025

These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of BuilderPro OS services, website, and software platform. By accessing or using BuilderPro OS, you agree to be bound by these terms.

Services

BuilderPro OS provides software tools designed to help businesses manage leads, automate communication, schedule appointments, manage customer relationships, and build marketing systems, including CRM, automation, website/funnel builders, appointment scheduling, messaging, reputation management, and AI-powered communication tools.

Account Responsibilities

Users are responsible for maintaining accurate account information, protecting their login credentials, and all activity occurring under their account. Users must not use the platform for illegal, abusive, or fraudulent activities.

Age Requirement

By using BuilderPro OS you confirm that you are at least 18 years old. Our services are intended for business owners and individuals legally able to enter into binding agreements.

Payments and Subscriptions

Certain services require paid subscriptions. By subscribing, you agree to pay all applicable fees, maintain valid payment information, and allow recurring billing where applicable. Payments may be processed through third-party providers such as Stripe.

Limitation of Liability

BuilderPro OS shall not be held liable for lost profits, lost business opportunities, or indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the platform. Use of the platform is at your own risk.

Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. Users may cancel their subscription at any time according to their billing terms.
